title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཛེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 188)
shelf_note: Authentic folio from the Pramāṇa (Tshad ma) section of the Derge Tengyur (volume Dze, vol. 188), containing a commentary on Buddhist epistemology regarding valid cognition and causal efficacy.

tr_errors_B.english: then conceptual cognition <term>kalpana</term> should not be investigated
tr_errors_B.problem: Misinterprets 'rtog pa dang ldan pas' (by a rational person/thinker) and 'shes pas' (through cognition) as meaning conceptual cognition itself should not be investigated

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A correctly translates 'rtog pa dang ldan pa' as a thinking agent investigating through cognition rather than mistaking it for conceptual cognition as the object of inquiry, and handles the epistemological argument with superior precision.

book_verdict: An authentic Derge Tengyur Pramāṇa folio with a flawless OCR transcription and a highly faithful English translation in Version A.
